question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.
sql:
WITH 
orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        o.exclusions,
        o.extras,
        o.order_time,
        n.pizza_name,
        unnest(string_to_array(REPLACE(p.toppings, ' ', ''), ',')) AS standard_topping_id
    FROM pizza_customer_orders o
    JOIN pizza_names n ON o.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes p ON o.pizza_id = p.pizza_id
),
exclusions_set AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        unnest(string_to_array(REPLACE(exclusions, ' ', ''), ',')) AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_customer_orders
    WHERE exclusions IS NOT NULL AND exclusions != ''
),
extras_set AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        n.pizza_name,
        o.order_time,
        unnest(string_to_array(REPLACE(o.extras, ' ', ''), ',')) AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_customer_orders o
    JOIN pizza_names n ON o.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
    WHERE o.extras IS NOT NULL AND o.extras != ''
),
final_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        o.pizza_name,
        o.order_time,
        o.standard_topping_id AS topping_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM exclusions_set e 
        WHERE e.order_id = o.order_id AND e.topping_id = o.standard_topping_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.customer_id,
        es.pizza_id,
        es.pizza_name,
        es.order_time,
        es.topping_id AS topping_id
    FROM extras_set es
),
counted_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        pizza_name,
        order_time,
        topping_id,
        COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM final_toppings
    GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_id
),
-- Join with pizza_toppings to get names
titled_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.order_id,
        ct.customer_id,
        ct.pizza_id,
        ct.pizza_name,
        ct.order_time,
        ct.topping_id,
        ct.count,
        t.topping_name
    FROM counted_toppings ct
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON ct.topping_id = t.topping_id
)
